⭕️ Resistance, perseverance, and four-dimensional care

To protect Iran against colonial and multi-stage weakening schemes (especially until a new equilibrium is achieved in the region), we need the following simultaneously and in synergy:

1️⃣ Military resistance
2️⃣ Diplomatic resistance
3️⃣ Social perseverance, and
4️⃣ Economic care for the most disadvantaged citizens

Any force that pays insufficient attention to any one of these four dimensions of national resistance and perseverance, and fails to accept what is required to strengthen them all at once, will inadvertently diminish our national endurance and capacity to make it through the formidable passes that lie ahead.

@jalaeipour
